meaning:
ἀκατάπαυστος, -ον
(καταπαύω),
that cannot cease, not to be restrained: with genitive of thing(s), 2Pe.2:14, T, Tr. txt.†
(AS)
glosses: desire for sin is never satisfied

renderings.bsb: their desire for sin is never satisfied

elsewhere.note: having eyes full of adultery, and who can’t cease from sin; enticing unsettled souls; having a heart trained in greed; children of cursing;
